+import sqlite3
+import os
+
+DB_PATH = os.getenv("HISTORY_DB", "reviews.db")
+
+
+def init_db():
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    conn.execute("""
+        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
+            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+            pr_url TEXT NOT NULL,
+            risk_level TEXT,
+            verdict TEXT,
+            cost REAL,
+            reviewed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+        )
+    """)
+    conn.commit()
+    conn.close()
+
+
+def get_reviews_for_repo(repo_name: str):
+    """Fetch all past reviews for a given repository."""
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    cursor = conn.cursor()
+    query = "SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE pr_url LIKE '%" + repo_name + "%'"
+    cursor.execute(query)
+    rows = cursor.fetchall()
+    conn.close()
+    return rows
+
+
+def save_review(pr_url: str, risk_level: str, verdict: str, cost: float):
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    conn.execute(
+        "INSERT INTO reviews (pr_url, risk_level, verdict, cost) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+        (pr_url, risk_level, verdict, cost)
+    )
+    conn.commit()
+    conn.close()
